name: cavemio-poll
title: Poll
description: A poll whose bars race to their share: vote, and every option fills with light while the percentages roll and live votes keep nudging them.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Before voting the options are a radio group of “Vote for …” buttons; after, each is named with its share and whether it’s your vote.
- Your vote is announced from a status region; live changes aren’t announced, so a busy poll never chatters.
- The fill is a scaled layer behind the text, so labels never move and the bars stay composited.
- Its light comes from your theme: the card mixes --primary-foreground into --primary, the rows are inset 1px edges and the fill is the same light at two strengths. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Number roll and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion the bars and numbers change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: options
props.description: – · { id, label, votes }; new counts glide the bars.

props.name: vote
props.description: – · The visitor’s vote from your data; with one, the results show.

props.name: onVote
props.description: – · Record a vote or a changed one; throw an Error to put the bars back and show why.

props.name: closesAt
props.description: – · Shows the time left; after it the results are final.

props.name: voters
props.description: – · A few recent voters, shown as faces with the count.

props.name: allowChange / source / locale
props.description: true / "Poll" / browser · Whether votes can change, who’s asking, and number formatting.

features.title: Results that arrive
features.description: Your vote fills every row to its share in turn and rolls the percentages up from zero.

features.title: Instant, then confirmed
features.description: The bars move on the tap; if onVote throws they go back and the reason shows.

features.title: Live without jumps
features.description: New counts from your data glide the bars and roll the numbers, never redraw them.

features.title: Change your mind
features.description: With allowChange, Change vote lets you tap another option and both rows move at once.

features.title: A clock
features.description: closesAt shows the days or hours left, then Final results and no more voting.

features.title: Who voted
features.description: A few voters’ faces and “Iris, Theo and 1,281 others” under the card.

states.title: ask
states.description: The lit card with the source, the vote count and time left, the question, and the options as inset rows with an empty ring.

states.title: reveal
states.description: Tapping fills each row with light to its share (900ms, 70ms apart) and rolls its percent from 0; your row is ringed and a check folds in; the leader is in full weight.

states.title: live
states.description: New counts glide the bars (700ms) and roll the numbers and the total.

states.title: change
states.description: Change vote (it morphs to Keep my vote) makes the other rows tappable; picking one moves both bars at once.

states.title: error
states.description: If onVote throws, the bars go back and the reason replaces the line under the card.

states.title: closed
states.description: After closesAt the results show with “Final results” and no row can be tapped.
